source_text.body:
Schedule social posts through an AI agent
A commenter ingests social content with Obsei and posts across networks via getlate.dev with an AI agent, except Reddit.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
In the Reddit thread, one commenter says their setup uses Obsei to ingest social content and getlate.dev to post it across social networks, excluding Reddit. They add that Socialclaw can connect that posting stack to Claude or another AI agent so the agent can schedule posts, but the thread does not spell out the workflow beyond those tool links.
How it went
The source gives no metrics or performance results. Its concrete limitation is that the posting workflow covers social networks except Reddit.
Worth knowing
The most actionable catch is scope: the commenter explicitly excludes Reddit from the automated posting setup.
Try it yourself
with
n8n
Copy prompt
Build a workflow that takes content from [source, like an RSS feed or spreadsheet], has an AI step adapt it for [platforms], and schedules the posts through [scheduling tool or API]. Add a manual approval step before anything is published, and show me the final text and schedule time. Finish with a test run using one sample post.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1s34qto/building_ai_agents_for_social_media_marketing
